metadata.technology_reasoning: Uncooled microbolometer thermal imaging sights are the industry standard for man-portable applications as of 2024 due to their compact size, reliability, low power consumption, and no need for cryogenic cooling, making them dominant in military and hunting markets.

components.reasoning: Core component detecting IR radiation and converting to electrical signals; universally present as the fundamental sensing element.
High-quality IR lenses focus thermal radiation onto the sensor; critical and separately manufactured due to specialized materials.
Includes the digital signal processor and electronics that convert sensor signals into usable thermal images; a distinct electronic module.
Displays the processed thermal image to the user; procured or integrated as a separate unit.
Provides portable electrical power; standardized battery packs are distinct components.
Protective casing made from durable materials for field use; structurally essential and typically manufactured separately.
Allows user operation of functions; often modular but sometimes integrated into housing.
